scope: Marin 11 + Napa 5 + Sonoma 9 + Solano 7 incorporated cities; selected additional events, openings and nationwide-chain offers usable only at participating local stores
methodology: Official city, library, venue, organizer, tourism-board and merchant pages were searched and opened. Direct-access failures and differences between indexed and live text are recorded below.
checkedAt/verifiedAt is the research date, not a claim that the announcement was first published that day. Calendar entries are deliberately labeled calendar and do not assert newly announced news.
Specific event dates refer to 2026. Ticket inventory, account-specific coupons, store participation and same-day cancellations were not verified through private accounts or purchases.
An official tourism-board report of an opening is paired with the merchant's operating website. openedOn is omitted without a verified first public-service date.

Current datasets and source titles were searched for duplicates. Existing Mill Valley Film Festival, Rio Vista Bass Derby, A Toast to Sausalito, Napa library seasonal programs and numerous October events were not duplicated as new MonthlyEvent rows.
Editor suggestions (arrival timing, combining a walk, checking a venue before leaving) are planning advice, not measured travel times or promises of admission.
